# nself-backup-stream.service
[Unit]
Description=nSelf streaming encrypted backup
After=network-online.target docker.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
Environment=PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
WorkingDirectory=<PROJECT>
ExecStart=<BINARY> backup stream --to r2:bkt/nself-web --recipient age1qqqq --recipient age1zzzz --heartbeat-to r2hb:hb
Nice=10
IOSchedulingClass=best-effort
IOSchedulingPriority=7
TimeoutStartSec=4h

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# nself-backup-stream.timer
[Unit]
Description=nSelf streaming backup: 30 2 * * *

[Timer]
Unit=nself-backup-stream.service
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:30:00 UTC
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=30s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
